text:
zoe: Heads-up from onboarding QA: inconsistent auth precedence across SDKs caused a sprint of support tickets. Quick summary and proposed checklist.

pri: TL;DR please?

zoe: Repro pattern: users set REDWOOD_API_KEY in their shell, then run sample app that has `~/.redwood/credentials` (from prior demo). Some SDKs pick the file first and ignore env -> 403s on project resources after rotation.

rahul: That mismatch is bad. Current ask: unify precedence and add non-breaking visibility.

zoe: Proposed short checklist: 
1) Consensus: env (REDWOOD_API_KEY) > credentials file (~/.redwood/credentials) > metadata server > interactive last-used suggestion.
2) Add opt-in debug: REDWOOD_DEBUG_AUTH=1 prints lookup_order and resolved_key_id (masked).
3) `rw auth rotate` should update in-process resolution when run in an interactive shell unless `--no-shell`.
4) Clear stale `~/.redwood/last-used` entry on successful rotate.
5) Docs: single auth cheat-sheet in each SDK README + one-line troubleshooting snippet for rotation.

pri: I like that. Two UX asks: print a one-line warning when falling back to org key while REDWOOD_PROJECT is set, and make the warning quiet unless interactive or REDWOOD_DEBUG_AUTH=1.

rahul: backend change: when scope mismatch occurs return structured error like `{"error":"scope_mismatch","attempted_key":"proj_****"}` (masked) to speed triage. I'll open a ticket with privacy review.

zoe: Tests: add a small CI job that runs a container matrix (env/file/last-used combos) asserting resolved key id. Keep job optional behind feature flag.

pri: I'll draft a doc PR with the cheat-sheet and sample-app README changes. Zoe, can you open a minimal CLI PR to align precedence + debug logging? Rahul, add backend ticket.

devex-bot: Reminder: update changelog and add migration guidance for users relying on previous last-used overrides.

zoe: timeline: PRs today, docs + tests next week. Thanks all! :rocket:
